about.what: Curated list of facilities (plants / sites) that Salish Sea terminals serve, with the EPA FRS records, Climate TRACE sources and WA Ecology SEPA Register searches that describe them. Two-refinery pilot approved by Josh 2026-10-06 (docs/PERMITS_SOURCES.md).
about.rules: Facts only. FRS ids were found with ECHO facility-name searches on 2026-10-06; each related id says why it is the same site (FRS name / street address exactly as ECHO lists them). Ids left out on purpose are listed with the reason. SEPA Register records are linked by rule (lib/ships/facilities.js sepaMatch): the applicant names one of applicant_words, the county matches, and the proposal or location names one of place_words; other search hits are kept as candidates and not shown.
about.licences: EPA ECHO: US Government work. WA Ecology SEPA Register: public record (credit + link). Climate TRACE: CC BY 4.0. BC EMA authorizations register: Open Government Licence – British Columbia (BC Data Catalogue). BC NRCED and BC EAO EPIC: public agency records (credit + link).
about.documents: documents: ecology_page = the facility's WA Ecology Industrial Section page slug; rcra = the RCRAInfo id its hazardous-waste corrective action permit belongs to; nwcaa.location = the facility's row name on NWCAA's Air Operating Permits page, nwcaa.aop = the AOP number in NWCAA's file names, nwcaa.icis_air = EPA's ICIS-Air id for the same air permit (ECHO DFR). Checked 2026-10-06. documents.pscaa: the facility's row on Puget Sound Clean Air Agency's approved Title V list (agency permit number) and EPA's ICIS-Air id for the same permit.
about.relations: terminals[]: relation 'serves' = the terminal is that plant's dock; 'owned_by' = a cited source says the facility's company owns/operates the terminal (source_url + says). coverage[]: a permit document states the permit covers the terminal (doc, where, its words; checked by reading the document 2026-10-06). paris_facility_ids: WA Ecology PARIS FacilityId(s), found by PARIS permit lookup of the facility's own permit. permit_holder_names: a permit whose holder name (as ECHO or PARIS lists it) contains one of these words is also this facility's, wherever it is filed.
about.bc: BC entries (country CA; DEV pilot 2026-10-07, docs/PERMITS_SOURCES_BC.md, lib/ships/bcPermits.js): point = the facility's point as its main BC EMA authorization lists it (the register gives west longitude without the minus sign). bc.ema.accepted = BC Environmental Management Act authorizations of the site, each hand-checked in the register file all_ams_authorizations.xlsx (downloaded 2026-10-07) against the berth points in bc.ema.berths (BC Ports and Terminals) and the company name, with why; left_out = register rows near the berths or with the company's name that are not this site, with why. bc.nrced = the NRCED searches and the rule (lib/ships/bcPermits.js nrcedMatch): a record is shown when it is issued to the company and names an accepted authorization number or the place. bc.eao = BC Environmental Assessment Office (EPIC) project searches; accepted projects name this site, candidates are kept but not shown.
